RAPID PILOT

Test what you are building with people who live the problem.

RAPID is a two-sided pilot. Founders bring a question; testers bring lived experience; the team turns the answers into evidence for the next decision.

Join as a tester
I have a test in mind

For adults aged 18 and above. Invitations depend on the needs of each test.

Apply once. Get invited when a test fits your experience. Read the terms and reward before you accept.

Join as a tester
I need evidence before I build

Describe the question and the people you need to reach. The team scopes the test and recruits matched testers.

Request a test

HOW IT WORKS

One loop, two sides

A test is not a survey. It is a scoped question answered by people who face it, with the evidence written down for the founder.

01
A founder asks

The founder describes what they need to learn and who needs to answer it.

02
The team scopes it

RAPID turns the request into a task, agrees the terms and reward, and decides who qualifies.

03
Testers respond

Matched testers read the terms, accept or decline, do the task and write what actually happened.

04
The founder decides

Findings show the evidence, the counts behind it and what the test cannot prove.

What each side walks away with

TESTERS

What testers get
Invitations matched to your experience, not a public task board.
The task, time and reward are stated before you accept.
Your name and contact details are not shared with founders.
Reward status is visible in your account after a test.
Join as a tester

FOUNDERS

What founders get
Recruitment counts with real denominators, not vanity metrics.
A summary of what testers did and what got in the way.
Published findings that state their limits as well as their signals.
A recorded build, iterate or pivot decision against the evidence.
Request a test

THE LIMITS

What the pilot does not promise
Matching is team-assisted. Applying does not guarantee an invitation.
A test does not guarantee payment, a place in a programme or a successful product.
The first pilot focuses on students, recent graduates and working adults in Nigeria.
No dashboard shows sample records. Empty means empty.
